**Unofficial build** of [Scroll-Walk](https://github.com/Naw7k/Scroll-Walk) 1.2 by Naw7k for Minecraft 26.1.x and 26.2 (Fabric), from its 26.1 source. Not affiliated with or supported by Naw7k — please don't report issues with this build upstream.

### Requirements
- Minecraft 26.1.x or 26.2, Fabric Loader, Fabric API
- Cloth Config and Mod Menu

### Changes
- The walking speed key is a normal key binding: **Walking speed (hold + mouse wheel)** in Options → Controls → Key Binds (category Scroll Walk), Left Alt by default. The original reads Left and Right Alt directly, which cannot be changed and clashes with other mods that use Alt. A mouse button works too.
- English and Hungarian names for the key binding.

Client-side only.

License: MIT (same as Scroll-Walk).
